Group rides in Tucson, AZ

5 recurring group rides around Tucson, AZ: 3 social, 2 road. 2 roll on weeknights, 2 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with BICAS WTF Ride in Tucson — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? The Shootout runs a 22–28+ mph; Scootout 19–23 mph; Old-Old Man 16–20 mph.
